Body.Content:
We are announcing the public preview of AKS support for dual-stack IPv6 overlay networking (Kubenet).

Dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 support is now available in AKS using the Kubenet overlay network plugin. Nodes, workloads, and services support IPv6 addresses alongside IPv4 addresses.

Learn more.
